name: sc-follow-two-humans
description: Strategy-card follows hold the turn with several human seats (no autopilot on forks: every seat is answered by hand). pbd28 r1: Mahact plays Leadership; End Turn is refused while Yssaril, Naaz and Deepwrought owe an answer. Mahact presses the upstream 'End Turn When All Have Reacted' (typed turn.action end_turn_when_followed); two humans answer (follow by influence-for-tokens / decline) and the last one's decline ends Mahact's turn by itself (Player.addFollowedSC hook): Deepwrought's turn menu opens. No one is auto-declined.
